instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out a business's unit economics (ARPU, gross margin, CAC, LTV, LTV to CAC, payback) from one period's revenue, costs, ad spend and customer counts", and give it net_revenue_cents (Revenue after refunds this period, in cents); gross_revenue_cents (Revenue before refunds this period, in cents); active_customers (Paying customers this period).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:work-out-unit-economics and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Takes one period's numbers in whole cents and counts and returns revenue per customer, gross margin, cost to win a customer, lifetime value, lifetime value to acquisition cost and months (periods) to earn back that cost.
